summary: Elevation Track E18A — Pastel watercolor Dream Memory Shrine carved limestone lantern prop (180x256 @ 2px/unit, 118 logical units tall matching the Wildlife Sanctuary birdbath scale) plus golden Star Trophy emblem (128x128), packed into public/assets/props/encore-shrine/encore-shrine.webp (19.3 KB, PSNR 48.28 dB, lossless alpha) and standalone star-trophy.webp (6.8 KB, PSNR 45.58 dB).
selectedRawSources: art/source/props/encore-shrine/star-trophy-raw.png (call 3, 1795844117778; call 2 rejected for UI text leakage from UI kit ref)

prompts.dreamShrine: Single centered 2D hand-painted watercolor-and-ink cozy RPG overworld prop: a charming storybook carved stone lantern shrine (Dream Memory Shrine) seen from a 3/4 overhead angle (about 40 degrees from above), matching the pale warm-grey limestone, soft cool blue-grey underside shadows, gentle upper-left daylight, and thin warm sepia-brown (#5B3530) ink outlines of the Wildlife Sanctuary stone birdbath. Compact rounded pedestal base with tiny sage-green moss tufts and two small butter-yellow wildflowers, carved four-point star motif, warm honey-amber and butter-yellow glowing lantern chamber, curved stone roof with star finial. Flat pure magenta #FF00FF background, zero pink/magenta on subject, zero ground shadow, zero text.
prompts.starTrophy: Single centered 2D hand-painted watercolor-and-ink cozy storybook collectible icon: a cute golden Star Trophy cup in butter-yellow and honey-gold watercolor washes with cream highlights, thin warm sepia-brown (#5B3530) ink outlines closing every edge from rim to solid rounded base, two looped handles, raised four-point star emblem on cup front, and soft periwinkle-blue ribbon bow on stem. Flat pure bright green #00FF00 background corner-to-corner, zero green inside trophy, zero text, zero drop shadow.

processing: dream-shrine: tools/art/key-alpha.ts --key #FF00FF --fuzz 22% --holes --despill none -> tools/art/despill-edge.ts --key magenta --band 4 -> tools/art/drop-islands.ts --min 180 -> trim, Lanczos scale to 236 px height, center on 180x256 RGBA canvas (8 px bottom margin, anchor 0.5 / 0.953125).

star-trophy: tools/art/key-alpha.ts --key #00FF00 --fuzz 22% --holes --despill none -> tools/art/despill-edge.ts --key green --band 4 -> tools/art/drop-islands.ts --min 180 -> trim, Lanczos scale into 112x112, center on 128x128 RGBA canvas.
Pack 320x256 spritesheet (dream-shrine at 0,0; star-trophy at 184,0) and encode with cwebp -q 92 -alpha_q 100 -m 6.

placement.notes: Open sunlit central-north meadow grass beside the northern dirt loop, 113+ units clear of all NPCs and 64+ units clear of all recorded sanctuary/festival footsteps.
